--- GM娴嬭瘯琛ュ伩绯荤粺锛堝鎴风璋冪敤锛屾湇鍔″櫒鎵ц妯℃嫙琛ュ伩锛?
---@param TestType number 1=鍗曠瑪 2=鎵归噺 3=璺ㄥ眬
---@param CommodityID number 鐗╁搧ID锛堥粯璁?001锛?
---@param Count number 鏁伴噺锛堥粯璁?锛?
function UGCPlayerController:Server_TestCompensation(TestType, CommodityID, Count)
    if not self:HasAuthority() then
        return
    end
    TestType = tonumber(TestType) or 1
    CommodityID = tonumber(CommodityID) or 1001
    Count = tonumber(Count) or 5

    print(string.format("[Compensation][GM] Server_TestCompensation: type=%d item=%d count=%d", TestType, CommodityID,
        Count))

    if TestType == 1 then
        -- 妯℃嫙鍗曠瑪琛ュ伩
        self:OnCompensateUGCCommodity(self.PlayerKey, 0, CommodityID, Count, 9000001)
    elseif TestType == 2 then
        -- 妯℃嫙鎵归噺琛ュ伩
        local list = {{
            CommodityID = CommodityID,
            Count = Count,
            ProductID = 9000001
        }, {
            CommodityID = CommodityID + 1,
            Count = Count + 2,
            ProductID = 9000002
        }}
        self:OnCompensateUGCCommodityBatch(self.PlayerKey, 0, list)
    elseif TestType == 3 then
        -- 妯℃嫙璺ㄥ眬鍟嗗搧鍙樺寲
        self:OnBuyUGCCommodityResultBetweenGames(self.PlayerKey, 0, CommodityID, Count)
    end
end

--[[----------------------娴嬭瘯鍏戞崲鐮?-----------------------]]
function UGCPlayerController:UseRedemptionCode(RedemptionCode)
    ugcprint("[RedemptionCode][ServerUse] enter PlayerKey=" .. tostring(self.PlayerKey) .. ", Code=" ..
                 tostring(RedemptionCode))
    if not self.bUseRedemptionCodeResultDelegateInit then
        self.bUseRedemptionCodeResultDelegateInit = true
        UGCCommoditySystem.UseRedemptionCodeResultDelegate:Add(self.OnUseRedemptionCodeResult, self)
        ugcprint("[RedemptionCode][ServerUse] result delegate registered")
    else
        ugcprint("[RedemptionCode][ServerUse] result delegate already registered")
    end

    local PlayerPawn = self:GetPlayerCharacterSafety()
    local UID = UGCPawnAttrSystem.GetPlayerUID(PlayerPawn)
    ugcprint("[RedemptionCode][ServerUse] PlayerPawn=" .. tostring(PlayerPawn) .. ", UID=" .. tostring(UID))
    print(string.format("[UseRedemptionCode] UID=%s Code=%s", tostring(UID), tostring(RedemptionCode)))
    ugcprint("[RedemptionCode][ServerUse] call UGCCommoditySystem.UseRedemptionCode")
    UGCCommoditySystem.UseRedemptionCode(tonumber(UID), RedemptionCode)
    ugcprint("[RedemptionCode][ServerUse] call finished")
end

--[[----------------------鎵撳嵃鍏戞崲鐮佺粨鏋?-----------------------]]
--[[----------------------娓呯┖鍏戞崲鐮佽緭鍏ユ------------------------]]
function UGCPlayerController:Client_ClearRedemptionCodeText()
    ugcprint("[RedemptionCode][ClientClear] enter MainUIInstance=" .. tostring(self.MainUIInstance))
    if self.MainUIInstance == nil or self.MainUIInstance.RedemptionCodeUI08Instance == nil then
        ugcprint("[RedemptionCode][ClientClear] missing ui instance, RedemptionCodeUI08Instance=" ..
                     tostring(self.MainUIInstance and self.MainUIInstance.RedemptionCodeUI08Instance or nil))
        return
    end

    local TextBox = self.MainUIInstance.RedemptionCodeUI08Instance.EditorUtilityEditableTextBox_216
    if TextBox ~= nil then
        ugcprint("[RedemptionCode][ClientClear] TextBox found, before=" .. tostring(TextBox:GetText()))
        TextBox:SetText("")
        ugcprint("[RedemptionCode][ClientClear] after=" .. tostring(TextBox:GetText()))
    else
        ugcprint("[RedemptionCode][ClientClear] TextBox nil")
    end
end

--[[----------------------鎵撳嵃鍏戞崲鐮佺粨鏋?-----------------------]]
function UGCPlayerController:OnUseRedemptionCodeResult(Result, PlayerKey, UID, CommodityID, Count, ProductID)
    ugcprint("[RedemptionCode][Result] enter Result=" .. tostring(Result) .. ", PlayerKey=" .. tostring(PlayerKey) ..
                 ", SelfPlayerKey=" .. tostring(self.PlayerKey) .. ", UID=" .. tostring(UID) .. ", CommodityID=" ..
                 tostring(CommodityID) .. ", Count=" .. tostring(Count) .. ", ProductID=" .. tostring(ProductID))
    if PlayerKey ~= self.PlayerKey then
        ugcprint("[RedemptionCode][Result] skip other player result")
        return
    end

    if Result == EUseRedemptionCodeResult.Success then
        print(string.format("[UseRedemptionCode] Success UID=%s CommodityID=%s Count=%s ProductID=%s", tostring(UID),
            tostring(CommodityID), tostring(Count), tostring(ProductID)))
        local Success, CommodityList = pcall(UGCCommoditySystem.GetUGCCommodityList, PlayerKey)
        ugcprint("[RedemptionCode][Result] GetUGCCommodityList success=" .. tostring(Success) .. ", list=" ..
                     tostring(CommodityList))
        if Success and CommodityList ~= nil then
            local Index = 0
            for Key, Item in pairs(CommodityList) do
                Index = Index + 1
                ugcprint("[RedemptionCode][Result] CommodityList[" .. tostring(Key) .. "]=" .. tostring(Item))
                if type(Item) == "table" then
                    for ItemKey, ItemValue in pairs(Item) do
                        ugcprint("[RedemptionCode][Result]   " .. tostring(ItemKey) .. "=" .. tostring(ItemValue))
                    end
                end
                if Index >= 10 then
                    break
                end
            end
            ugcprint("[RedemptionCode][Result] CommodityList count logged=" .. tostring(Index))
        end
        ugcprint("[RedemptionCode][Result] call Client_ClearRedemptionCodeText")
        UnrealNetwork.CallUnrealRPC(self, self, "Client_ClearRedemptionCodeText")
    else
        print(string.format("[UseRedemptionCode] Failed Result=%s UID=%s PlayerKey=%s", tostring(Result), tostring(UID),
            tostring(PlayerKey)))
        ugcprint("[RedemptionCode][Result] failed, no clear")
    end
end

return UGCPlayerController

我看了 `chongzita`，它那边代码本身也只是调用 `UseRedemptionCode`，没有手动加背包。真正差异在 Douluo：兑换成功后虽然虚拟物品 `1001` 已经加成功，但我们之前没有主动把成功结果接到你项目现有的获得弹窗路径。

我已经改了 [UGCPlayerController.lua](C:/WeGameApps/rail_apps/OasisEraEditor(2001776)/ShadowTrackerExtra/UGCProjects/Douluo/Script/Blueprint/UGCPlayerController.lua:2713)：

- 兑换成功后会额外调用 `Client_CompensationReceived`
- 客户端会走 `ShopV2Manager:ShowItemGetPopup(CommodityID, Count)`
- 增加日志：`[RedemptionCode][ClientRewardPopup] ShowItemGetPopup MainUI=...`

还有一个重要点：测试环境兑换码默认给的是 `CommodityID=1001`，但 Douluo 的 `ShopV2Manager:OnAddVirtualItem` 背包映射表里没有 `1001`，所以它不一定会转成斗罗背包里的 `831xxxx` 道具。下次你运行后，看日志里 `ClientRewardPopup` 的 `MainUI` 是否为 nil；如果弹窗出来但背包仍不进，那就需要把 `1001` 映射到你想给的斗罗背包道具 ID。
